scope: Current route-wait/refresh helper comparison and explicit precision gap; not another full29-file/controller review.

dispositions.source: routeWaiting protects near-waypoint HOLD, inactive trigger, positive timeout and nontrue condition; it does not execute condition code.
dispositions.current: DrivingAssistStart near-waypoint wait also requires stationary/unitReady. DrivingRouteGoal separately refuses non-MOVE, code/script, timeout, attachments and synchronization even at a distance. Retain this stricter recovery boundary; no bypass selected.

dispositions.intent: Restore a native route after temporary driving work
dispositions.source: refreshRoute throttles3s; commanded-vehicle branch avoids fixed paths and issues commander doMove. Other branch may end a path, forceSpeed -1, enable MOVE/PATH, delete/recreate current waypoint and recall selected crew. It copies many fields but is not CBE exact-owner handback.
dispositions.current: Keep CBE original-route/seat/native command receipts and finite handback acknowledgement. Do not adopt blanket speed/AI-feature release or authored waypoint replacement. Inspection did not prove a new CBE regression requiring such a change.

dispositions.source: precision caches5s, explicit per-vehicle override precedes optional player-distance low mode. playersNear uses altitude/body-direction heuristic for hidden recovery and is not visibility proof.
dispositions.current: CBE driving phase schedules4s cruise/1s constrained callbacks; FollowingCap explicitly budgets4s reaction time and6s prediction horizon. HBQ-style per-vehicle precision and player-distance observation LOD are not implemented by that phase cadence. Preserve this gap; do not claim parity or weaken geometric safety because an observer is distant.

costDecision: No cadence/sensor reduction selected without response-latency, observation-age and physical safety evidence. Existing4s reaction accounting means a quicker-looking interval is not by itself a demonstrated correction. No performance acceptance claimed.
validation: Read-only source comparison and source hashes. Prior precision/recovery reviews were consulted; this does not add four new source implementations or raise percentages. No source change/build/audit. Audits remain paused; whole production goal incomplete.
